recentItems.title: ⚠️ #M72 RETURNS TO NORTH AMERICA IN 2027 ⚠️ Tickets on sale September 25. More info at Metallica.com
Metallica: M72 World Tour Returns to North America
recentItems.description:
We’ve added 12 additional North American shows in 2027, and we’ll be joined by tour buddies Limp Bizkit and Avatar, who are returning to our M72 party. Tickets go on sale Friday, September 25, with presales beginning Monday, September 21. For more information, visit https://metallica.lnk.to/M72WorldTour2027

Of course, we’ll have the same unique stadium production at mid-field in-the-round, with the Snake Pit in the center of the stage providing a complete 360° view of the show. The festivities kick off on May 8, 2027, in Vancouver, Canada. This time around, we’ll be playing single shows, visiting a mix of NFL/CFL stadiums, colleges, and the homes of both men’s and women’s soccer teams. We’re covering a lot of ground from Buffalo all the way across the country to San Diego and many points in between, wrapping up in Salt Lake City on June 19.

Enhanced Experiences¹, Lux Æterna Private Platforms², I Disappear Tickets³, and Travel Packages will all be available throughout the M72 2027 North American run. For more information, visit https://superfan.live/metallica and https://metallicatravel.com.

Fan Club Presales for all ticket types will begin on Monday, September 21, with Legacy Members at 10 AM Local Time and all other Fifth Members at 12 PM Local Time. For more information, visit https://metallica.lnk.to/M72Presales2027

Hardwired (Live in Minneapolis, MN - August 20, 2016) (Black Box Edit)
recentItems.description:
Recorded live at U.S. Bank Stadium in Minneapolis, MN, on August 20, 2016, this is the live debut of "Hardwired" and, as it turns out, the unofficial kickoff of the entire WorldWired tour. A live clip hit our YouTube channel back in 2016, put together with a quick & dirty audio mix by Mike Gillies and Marcia Kapustin's program cut. It was good enough for the moment, but nowhere near what this song deserves. So, in honor of its 10th Anniversary, we went back and did it right. The audio's been swapped for the live mix featured on the Deluxe Edition of “Hardwired...To Self-Destruct,” with Greg Fidelman's thunderous take that will hit you like a freight train. Jeff Yeager went spelunking into The Metallica Black Box once again, clawing his way to footage from 15 different cameras buried in his tour archive, and Brett Murray took it and ran wild, cranking out an exciting, pulse-racing edit that moves as fast as the song does. Best part: this show went down just a couple of days after “Hardwired” dropped out of nowhere and “Hardwired...To Self-Destruct” got announced, so the crowd is hearing it for the very first time... and you can feel it. No surprise it's one of Spider-Dan's all-time favorites, right up there in his arsenal of rare cuts and live debuts that assault the eardrums of Maximum Metallica listeners on SiriusXM. Turn it up loud and let it rip.

Mixed by Greg Fidelman
Recorded by Mike Gillies

Tour Video Director: Marcia Kapustin
Edited by Brett Murray
Filmed by the Metallica Video Crew
Additional Footage Filmed by Jeff Yeager, Brett Murray & Dan Nykolayko

Tour Archive Managed by Jeff Yeager
Curated by Dan Nykolayko

“Hardwired” was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich, and was originally released in 2016 on the album “Hardwired...To Self-Destruct.”

Metallica: Shadows Follow (Live in East Rutherford, NJ - August 4, 2023) (Black Box Edit)
recentItems.description:
Filmed live at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, NJ, on August 4, 2023, during the M72 World Tour's North American kickoff, this is the live debut of a thundering behemoth known as "Shadows Follow." A tour video went up not long after the show, but don't let that fool you: this is a different animal. For our Lost & Found series, we went back to the vault to build a fresh cut from the original iso cams. Jeff Yeager dug up footage from 23 different cameras, buried deep in the bowels of The Metallica Black Box, and handed it off to Brett Murray, who dove in and carved out a fresh edit. SiriusXM's Maximum Metallica listeners might already know this one — Spider-Dan keeps it in rare rotation. Crank it and enjoy.

Mixed by The Team at Factory Six
Recorded by Jason Gossman

Tour Video Director: Gene McAuliffe
Edited by Brett Murray
Filmed by the Metallica Video Crew
Additional Footage Filmed by Jeff Yeager & Brett Murray

Tour Archive Managed by Jeff Yeager
Curated by Dan Nykolayko

Full concert audio from this show is available on CD and to stream or download: https://metallica.lnk.to/LiveInEastRutherford2023Night1

“Shadows Follow” was written by James Hetfield and Lars Ulrich, and was originally released in 2023 on the album “72 Seasons.”
